US Envoy Seeks Gaza Peace Amid Israeli Strikes and Hamas Talks

US envoy Jared Kushner met with Hamas leaders in Cairo to discuss a Gaza peace plan, which includes Hamas disarmament and Israeli withdrawal from Gaza. The plan, approved by Donald Trump, has been accepted by Palestinian factions but rejected by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Kushner is scheduled to visit Israel following the Cairo meetings. Meanwhile, Israeli airstrikes have resumed in Gaza, impacting an area with approximately 2 million residents. Several nations have condemned Israel's rejection of the US-backed roadmap, calling it a blow to peace efforts.
